node.statement: Unit comparison: by lem-compcb-corner-algebra, S_P is an extended C_ca e-C*-algebra with compressed unit u_P=Co_P(P). The unit axiom for the extended delta-isomorphism v gives ||R-u_P||<=delta. The compression estimate in def-compressed-corner gives ||u_P-P(PP)||=O(e)||P||, while ||P(PP)-P||<=((1+epsilon)||P||+1)delta; therefore ||R-P||<=C_1 e with a universal C_1.
